skill.displayName: 小红书评论分析与需求挖掘

version.changelog: Refresh API Key guidance to the SocialDataX AI access page.

llm.summary: This skill is a coherent read-only Xiaohongshu comment analysis helper that uses a disclosed SocialDataX API key and Node CLI package.

dimensions.detail: Network access and an API key are proportionate to fetching hosted social-media data; the skill discloses that it does not read browser data, log in, post, like, comment, or change accounts.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill declares Node/npm and SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY, and examples use npx socialdatax-skills@latest; the referenced npm package has no lifecycle scripts, but @latest means future package updates are not pinned.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to SocialDataX/XHS comment tools, preserve pagination tokens, disclose partial coverage, and separate returned comment evidence from analysis.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact shows no background worker, persistence, credential storage, browser-profile access, or account mutation; pagination can be broad with --all, but it is user-directed data retrieval.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is XHS comment/reply retrieval and analysis, and the artifact instructions only direct the agent to fetch comments or sub-comments from user-provided note IDs or URLs.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable using SocialDataX to fetch XHS comment data with your SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY. Prefer bounded options such as --pages or --max-items for large notes, and be aware that the npx examples use the latest npm package version at runtime.
